rules: Preserve inward layers and SDK ownership in pyproject.toml and tests/test_architecture.py. Process effects remain in runtime/queue adapters; test libraries and harnesses never become production dependencies.

modules.responsibility: Validate Linux supervision primitives before native work, retain identity-safe process cleanup.
modules.interface: require_process_supervision() -> None; actionable RuntimeError before training on unavailable Python or kernel capabilities; existing cleanup semantics remain strict.
modules.effects: Own only bounded process-capability probes, close descriptors and preserve process state.

modules.responsibility: Check worker and snapshot interpreter capabilities before admission or launch. Integrate GPU control service operations with existing verified recovery and preserve pending or failed job truth when manual overrides are used.
modules.interface: Existing worker_registration/start interfaces; failed capability checks leave pending work unclaimed and report the interpreter and capability.
modules.effects: Own bounded interpreter probes before prepare_start; preserve existing reservation and process ownership.

modules.responsibility: Confirm supervision support in the guardian process before acquiring a lease or opening a launch gate.
modules.interface: Existing guardian lifecycle; no training on failed capability checks; uncertain active cleanup still quarantines resources.
modules.effects: Own guardian startup probe and established lifecycle; never release unverified live claims.

modules.responsibility: Exercise capability failures, real composed workflows, generated invariants and opt-in physical multi-GPU DDP with portable evidence.
modules.interface: Existing pytest tests plus process_capabilities, gpu_controls and ddp_gpu markers; explicit GPU opt-in, physical device/project/artifact options; default suite stays offline.
allowed_dependencies: installed SDKs in explicitly selected integration tests
forbidden_dependencies: test packages in runtime dependency declarations
modules.effects: Own temporary fixtures, bounded test subprocesses and selected GPU/ClearML runs; preserve unrelated resources; record redacted diagnostics.

modules.responsibility: Pure GPU hold/status/release records and allocation policy.
modules.interface: Typed host/UUID/actor/reason records and disabled-capacity decisions; no runtime effects.

modules.responsibility: Expose GPU list/disable/enable/release through injected ports and propagate exclusion reasons.
modules.interface: Typed GPU-control port and additive QueueService operations; effective holds exclude all new host allocations.

modules.responsibility: Resolve physical selectors and orchestrate audited whole-allocation operator release with queue state and process ownership.
modules.interface: GPUControls.list/disable/enable/release through QueueGPUControlPort; expected immutable claim token guards whole-allocation release.
allowed_dependencies: runtime GPU identity and process supervision adapters
modules.effects: Own original-root queue transaction before host GPU transaction, bounded ownership verification/normal cleanup, audit-before-release and failed-job recording. Force never signals.

modules.responsibility: Persist owner holds and admission fence, recheck holds during allocation, and acquire complete recovery leases.
modules.interface: LocalGPULocks hold/fence/transaction interfaces and GPULease whole-allocation release; held/live leases and changed claims refuse release.
modules.effects: Own atomic host-local hold/fence records, host transactions and GPU descriptors; whole-allocation claim checks precede removal.

modules.responsibility: Parse GPU operator commands and present typed results and errors.
modules.interface: cy-queue gpu list/disable/enable/release; physical integer or full UUID selectors, reason, expected claim token and explicit force flag.
modules.effects: Compose injected adapters and handle CLI I/O; no embedded allocation or signal policy.

modules.responsibility: Expose physical-index UUID enumeration for administration without requiring CUDA visibility or memory health.
modules.interface: Public identity-only physical enumeration, stable UUID outputs and explicit invalid-selector failures.
modules.effects: Own balanced NVML lifecycle, no CUDA initialization or model loads.

modules.responsibility: Expose caller-held queue transaction update for audited release while preserving NFS-before-GPU lock order.
modules.interface: transaction_update under existing store.transaction; update retains ordinary transaction wrapper.
modules.effects: Own durable failed job state update before capacity removal; no nested transaction acquisition.

contracts.rules: Inward layers, SDK ownership, standard-library process adapter boundaries and direct-entrypoint independence from queue.
Executable checks reject Hypothesis/coverage as runtime dependencies and production imports of test harnesses, including injected violations.

checks.command: uv run --frozen --no-sync lint-imports && uv run --frozen --no-sync pytest tests/test_architecture.py
checks.expectation: Production graph and injected forbidden-edge cases pass; execute commands separately for evidence.
Test-tool dependency ownership and negative cases pass.
Offline suite passes; GPU tests deselect without opt-in; missing pidfd cases reject before model work and reservation.
Explicitly selected physical multi-GPU direct/queued eager/compiled training, validation, publication and failure-cleanup scenarios pass; unavailable prerequisites are reported as failed acceptance.

result.reason: User will provide results from a separate physical multi-GPU machine; no CPU/mocked substitution. T016 remains open.

checks.command: Validate changed Markdown, local links and documented pytest collection/selection commands.
checks.expectation: Development, queue and remote DDP instructions match implementation; commands select exactly the promised tests.
Cross-root/actor holds, allocation races, stale claim tokens, live owner/lock refusal, full-allocation force release and audit/crash recovery pass with real local process/lock tests.

documentation: Update docs/development.md, docs/queue.md and runtime isolation guidance; add docs/ddp-testing.md with prerequisites, exact selection commands, result bundle and interpretation. Record dated observations under the new Spec Kit feature. Include CLI GPU controls, operator override semantics, whole-allocation release, cross-user hold ownership, and a coordinated host-wide worker upgrade with mixed-version admission fencing.

review.reconciliation: Reviewed actual production diff and new tests/docs, including LocalGPULocks hold/fence persistence, GPUControls orchestration, NFS-before-GPU transaction storage, test-only observers and helper-readiness correction. Runtime versions and approved dependencies unchanged; excludes pre-existing local uv sources and unrelated grid-search document. Accepted local source scope; external physical check remains not-run and blocks overall architecture acceptance.
